definition: HKChat (Chinese: 港話通) is a large language model-based chatbot developed by HKChat OmniServe Limited (Chinese: 港話通全維服務有限公司) in Hong Kong.
details: HKChat (Chinese: 港話通) is a large language model-based chatbot developed by HKChat OmniServe Limited (Chinese: 港話通全維服務有限公司) in Hong Kong.
story: Imagine learning a language by reading every book in the library and noticing, over time, which words travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It is fluency built from pattern, not from memorized rules. That pattern-earned fluency is HKChat.
